svg.title: OneGrid - regulated workload boundaries
svg.desc: Separate OT publication, workload queries, model processing, identity and retained evidence

g.title: PI / historian / SCADA - Approved source read UTC time / quality flags
Source connector - Durable outbound publication Checkpoint / certificate
Approved enterprise data - Assets / maintenance Classified work records
Fabric Eventstream - Approved custom source Mapped destination
Fabric Eventhouse - PiEvents / PCIOutages Explicit KQL permissions
OneLake / Lakehouse - Classified curated data Verified data-access roles
Import semantic model - OneGridModelImport Test SQL / model / export access
Microsoft Entra ID - Conditional Access Privileged access review
Enterprise ingress / WAF - TLS / origin restrictions / approved callbacks REST and WebSocket access tests
Azure App Service - OneGrid - Scoped runtime identity and tool authorization Human-reviewed operational recommendations
Azure OpenAI - Approved model / processing geography Grounding and prompt/tool evaluation
Planetary Computer Pro - Classified imagery and asset context Catalog / Blob permissions
Weather / Aurora pipeline - Approved GFS -> job -> managed endpoint Timestamped normalized Blob outputs

text.tspan: Configure exports for identity, app, Fabric, job, model and deployment events; correlate timestamps and retain provenance
Access reviews | positive / negative tests | model approvals | forecast lineage | recovery exercises
Separate OT publication, workload queries, model processing, identity and retained evidence
Arrowheads indicate the initiator of a request or the destination of data. Optional components are labeled; dashed boundaries mark a separately controlled scope.
